title: Crunching Numbers Just for You
statementMd:
You are developing a new feature for the website which sells airline tickets: being able to sort tickets by price! You have already extracted the tickets' prices, so there's just the last step to be done...

You are given an array of integers. Sort it in non-descending order.

## Input

The input consists of a single line of space-separated integers. The first number is $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$) — the size of the array. The following $*n*$ numbers are the elements of the array ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$).

## Output

Output space-separated elements of the sorted array.

## Note

Remember, this is a very important feature, and you have to make sure the customers appreciate it!
statementZhMd:
你正在为一家销售机票的网站开发一项新功能：能够按价格对机票进行排序！你已经提取出了机票的价格，现在只剩下最后一步了……

给定一个整数数组。请将其按非递减顺序排序。

## 输入格式

输入由一行以空格分隔的整数构成。第一个数是 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$），表示数组的大小。接下来的 $*n*$ 个数是数组的元素（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。

## 输出格式

输出排序后的数组元素，各元素之间用空格分隔。

## 说明

请记住，这是一项非常重要的功能，你必须确保顾客喜欢它！
